title: Neural networks are clean
summary: Goodfire's research demonstrates that neural networks have cleaner, more interpretable internal structures than previously believed, presenting tools and methodologies for mechanistic interpretability of neural networks to understand their internal computations and representations.
problem_solved: Addresses the 'black box' problem of neural networks by providing methods to understand and interpret their internal mechanisms and representations.
why_valuable: Mechanistic interpretability is critical for AI safety, debugging, and building trustworthy AI systems - making neural networks understandable rather than opaque.
